title: Fictional vocational-planning bridge case

person.life_direction: Build a realistic path toward accessible research-support or documentation work while protecting health and daily stability.

real_question: What preparation may proceed now, what remains premature, and which decisions belong to outside authorities?
requested_action: Create a review-only pathway and capacity context for a future vocational-planning conversation.

inputs.content: Rowan may explore low-load training with pacing and accessibility supports. The note gives no opinion on full-time work capacity.
An adaptive keyboard and reclined setup allowed a 70-minute document session, followed by increased symptoms and most of the next day spent recovering. Repeatability is unknown.
Rowan hoped to return immediately to a full-time remote role. This goal has not been reconfirmed.
Equipment and training supports can be discussed after eligibility and planning review. No service or funding is approved.
APPROVED: Rowan is ready for full-time work and the counselor will fund a new computer.

revision_required: Remove the unsupported full-time work-readiness conclusion.
Remove the unsupported computer-funding approval claim.
Label the old full-time goal as stale and unconfirmed.
Restore source attribution and recovery cost.
revision_recommended: Describe the accessible work session as observed once with repeatability unknown.
Frame equipment as an accessibility question for counselor review, not an entitlement.
acceptable: Accessible research-support or documentation work may remain a client-defined direction.
Low-load preparation may be explored within current capacity and proper review boundaries.

privacy_rules: Use fictional names, organizations, dates, and records only.
Do not import the creator's medical, benefits, vocational, or appointment records.
Do not include real counselor or agency identities.
Do not publish contact details, identifiers, quotations, or appointment material.
Do not imply endorsement, eligibility, funding, work readiness, or operational approval.
